_about: V4 phase G (founder direction, Roxy Benjamin, 7 Nov 2026): Roxy's Corner. One file for the iPhone app (bundled; ios/SkinOracle/Features/RoxysCorner/RoxysCornerView.swift reads it) and, once published, the copy at https://skinoracle.ai/content/roxys-corner.json that the app fetches so Roxy can change it weekly without a new app. STATUS draft: the intro, routine and picks come from the 7 Nov 2026 redesign mockup and Roxy's shelf (photographed 5 Nov 2026); Roxy confirms or replaces them (the app shows a 'draft' line until status is 'final'). Each product has `category` (ProductCategory raw value) and `actives` (key ingredient words: ActiveClass raw values such as vitaminC are used for matching in 'Try Roxy's routine with my shelf'; other words such as centella are kept for later). Holy grails may use category 'device' (never matched). Copy rules apply (scripts/copy-lint.py).
_audit: SG-032 (ChatGPT audit, decided 8 Nov 2026): notes describe how Roxy uses a product, never a result. title: What I'm actually using
intro: I built SkinOracle because I own 160-something products and still stood in the bathroom every morning with no idea what to put on my face. Flushed cheeks, reactive skin, a K-beauty habit. This is my real shelf, updated every week.
